price_book_window_chk.name: price_book_window_chk
price_book_window_chk.value: "shelfline"."price_book"."valid_from" is null or "shelfline"."price_book"."valid_to" is null or "shelfline"."price_book"."valid_from" <= "shelfline"."price_book"."valid_to"

promotion_value_chk.name: promotion_value_chk
promotion_value_chk.value: ("shelfline"."promotion"."kind" = 'percent' and "shelfline"."promotion"."value_bp" between 1 and 10000 and "shelfline"."promotion"."amount_minor" = 0) or ("shelfline"."promotion"."kind" = 'amount_off' and "shelfline"."promotion"."amount_minor" > 0 and "shelfline"."promotion"."value_bp" = 0)

promotion_window_chk.name: promotion_window_chk
promotion_window_chk.value: "shelfline"."promotion"."valid_from" is null or "shelfline"."promotion"."valid_to" is null or "shelfline"."promotion"."valid_from" <= "shelfline"."promotion"."valid_to"

report_grant_range_chk.name: report_grant_range_chk
report_grant_range_chk.value: ("shelfline"."report_grant"."range_kind" = 'fixed' and "shelfline"."report_grant"."range_from" is not null and "shelfline"."report_grant"."range_to" is not null and "shelfline"."report_grant"."range_to" >= "shelfline"."report_grant"."range_from" and "shelfline"."report_grant"."rolling_days" is null) or ("shelfline"."report_grant"."range_kind" = 'rolling' and "shelfline"."report_grant"."rolling_days" between 1 and 366 and "shelfline"."report_grant"."range_from" is null and "shelfline"."report_grant"."range_to" is null)
